title: Learning Across Temporal Graph Representation Silos
abstract: arXiv:2610.19576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal graph data are recorded in different representations, but whether these differences also determine the scope of learned knowledge reuse remains unclear. This study investigates whether predictive structure learned from relational histories can be reused between continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) and temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs). Bidirectional reuse emerges while retaining distinct input and prediction interfaces and independent vocabularies, and sources with the same representation are not always more useful. Controlled reorganizations of source histories show that the organization contributing to reuse varies across source-target conditions. We show that learned aspects of Relational Dynamics, the predictive structure present in relational histories, can be reused across conventional representation boundaries. translated_title: 跨越时序图表示孤岛的学习
translated_abstract: 时序图数据以不同的表示形式被记录，但这些差异是否也决定了所学知识复用的范围仍不清楚。本研究探讨了从关系历史中学习到的预测结构能否在连续时间动态图（CTDG）和时序知识图谱（TKG）之间进行复用。研究表明，在保留各自独立的输入与预测接口以及独立词表的情况下，双向复用得以实现，且相同表示形式的数据源并不总是更有用。对源历史的受控重组实验显示，促成复用的数据组织方式因源-目标任务组合而异。我们证明了关系历史中存在的预测结构——关系动力学（Relational Dynamics）——的某些习得方面可以跨越传统的表示边界进行复用。此外，独立预训练的TKG和CTDG学习器还可以在分数层面进行融合，从而提升预测性能。
tldr: 该研究首次证明关系历史中学习到的预测结构（关系动力学）能够跨越连续时间动态图与时序知识图谱之间的传统表示边界实现双向知识复用，且独立预训练的两类模型还可在分数层面融合以提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that predictive structures learned from relational histories (Relational Dynamics) can be bidirectionally reused across traditional representation boundaries between continuous-time dynamic graphs and temporal knowledge graphs, and independently pretrained learners of both types can be fused at the score level to improve prediction.
